correctness.rationale: For each 2 in a word, new scattered 012 triples equal prior 01 pairs. Nondecreasing pair counts force exactly the contribution compositions (2) and (1,1). First productive 1, pre-pair 2 insertions and last positive 2 give three exhaustive disjoint regular-language products. Their generating functions sum to z^4(3-z)/((1-z)^3(1-2z)^2), and coefficient extraction yields the exact formula for every n>=1, with B_0=0. Finite independent direct and transfer checks corroborate through n=11 and n=50 respectively, but are not used to establish the infinite identity.
